facts.title: overlap
facts.tagline: do two segments trace the same papyrus, and do their ink maps agree there
facts.success: Exit code 0, and for labels a non-null `labels.dice`.
facts.not_a_pass: a label Dice or a map agreement without its displaced null; `collate` without both control maps; a bin whose `map` is null; reading `same_sheet_share` under 0.1 as proof of two sheets (0.1 is a fixed cut, not a test); taking a gap bin as a normal offset; agreement of maps the model trained on (the team's PHerc0841 maps are probably in-sample).
facts.never: Call two agreeing ink maps a reading or say letters were found; use either command's result to say which trace is right; publish collate results on target-scroll meshes.
